summary: Deployed budget is 8192 (H100 usage-context default), so the 6000-token prompt fits in step 1 behind 10 decodes; with --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 the model gives 2038/2038/1924 chunks, no tokens from partial chunks, first token at step 3, end to end through engine-core.step. Seam defect W2 with prompt_segments.
Deployed 8192/1024 admits all 200 prompts in step 1; under 2048/128 the model gives 102 full + an 8-token chunk, then caps running at 128.
--no-enable-chunked-prefill with 2048 < max_model_len 8192 fails SchedulerConfig.verify_max_model_len inside create_engine_config; vllm serve never reaches engine-core.init.

FCFS self-preemption of the last running request, status PREEMPTED, computed 0, prepended to waiting, blocks freed to the tail; resume recomputes prompt+output minus the prefix hit (1 token), num_preemptions 1, no duplicate output.
Priority victim is max(priority, arrival); the already-scheduled victim's tokens are returned; the requester gets the freed block.
Priority-0 arrival heads the heap, fails allocation without preempting, and is admitted first after blocks free.
Full-block hashing, a 32-token hit for 40 tokens, and the num_tokens-1 cap for 48 tokens all reproduced; the hash stand-in lacks extra keys (LoRA, cache_salt, mm).
LRU eviction (tail block first, hash dropped) passes; cache_salt and LoRA isolation are not modeled: the model shares 32 tokens across salts and adapters.
